name: Monili VLR
about: Monili VLR is a software factory run with AI agents. Each product is a tool an AI assistant (ChatGPT or Claude) can use: you write a sentence, the tool does real work.

products.name: ThirdBrain-PII
products.summary: Use Claude on real work and keep real names to yourself. Personal data is replaced in your browser and comes back only for you.
products.example_prompt: Summarise this contract without sending the names.
products.how_to_get: A custom connector for Claude (claude.ai). Ask for the connector address through the Monili VLR contact form.

tools.name: thirdbrain_open
tools.description: Shows the panel in the chat. No input. Read-only, not destructive, closed world.

tools.name: thirdbrain_continue
tools.description: Shows the panel again after an answer, with that answer at the top. Its only input is Claude's answer, which holds placeholders only (max 20,000 characters); it is not kept, logged or returned.

tools.name: thirdbrain_help
tools.description: Returns the user guide of the panel as fixed text, the same for everyone. No input.

products.name: T-Shadow
products.summary: A Windows security guardian that works inside Claude. It blocks with undo and explains every alarm in plain words.
products.example_prompt: Is anything strange running on my PC?
products.how_to_get: A Windows guardian plus a Claude plugin (Claude Code and Cowork). Public test not open yet: ask for access through the Monili VLR contact form.
